**CALIFORNIA COMMERCIAL LEASE AGREEMENT**

This Lease Agreement made the 2025-05-11 , by and between Jackie Gerhold [name of lessor], of
653 Woodside Road [street address], State of California , hereinafter referred to as "Lessor", and Lemke Inc [name
of lessee], of 152 Lettia Landing [street address], State of California , hereinafter referred to as "Lessee", collectively
referred to herein as the "Parties", agree as follows:

**1. DESCRIPTION OF LEASED PREMISES:**

The Lessor agrees to lease to the Lessee the following described 9388 square feet (SF) of Office Space located
at 17803 Gorczany Throughway [street address], State of California.

**2. TERM OF LEASE:**

The term of this Lease shall be for a period of 2 year(s) 10 month(s) commencing on the
11 day of May 2025 day of May 2025 , and expiring at Midnight on the 11 day of
March 2028 day of March 2028 . ("Initial Term")

**3. BASE RENT:**

The net monthly payment shall be 3400 dollars ($3400) per month. A security deposit of 2089 dollars ($2089)
is required. payable monthly with the first payment due upon the is required. payable monthly with the first payment due upon the
commencement of the Lease and each monthly installment payable thereafter on the 1st day of each month

**4. Options to Renew (Check one):**

☑ Lessee may not renew the Lease.
☑ The Lessee may have the right to renew the Lease with a total of ____ renewal period(s) with each term being
____ year(s) ____ month(s) which may be exercised by giving written notice to Lessor no less than 60 days prior to
the expiration of the Lease or renewal period.
